title: Value figure shown with no basis or source; fsa and prompt-pay values contradict their own basis
expected: Each Value states it is the author's estimate with its basis and sources beside it, agreeing with the basis text
got: economics.basis is never parsed; sources parsed but rendered by no chores view; only label is 'for the persona'. fsa basis says no programme dollar exists yet shows $10,000/yr (75x world $132.65); prompt-pay $3,500/yr is 8x world $440.16 and ~130x Devon's own ~$27 (18,600 x 4.75% x 11/360)
suggested_acceptance: Topic Value tile shows an 'estimate' label and an expandable basis with sources; a test fails if value_usd > 10x world_total without a basis sentence explaining it

title: Time saved and 'x faster' exclude the person's review time, which is computed but not rendered
expected: Time saved counts the person's review and says it was measured on invented data, n runs
got: beforeAfterOf builds 'your review N min' but topic renders only the two figures and ratio. Shown vs with-review: bid 50x/16x, crop 66x/39x, erate 129x/62x, prompt 39x/22x, fsa 64x/26x, grant 142x/75x, records 69x/22x, restricted 64x/29x; Characters expect ~4x (Devon) and ~3x (Ruth)
suggested_acceptance: Ratio uses manual / (bench + your_time); the review minutes and 'measured on invented data, n=1' render under the figure

title: 'Rehearsal shaped like your case' plays the example persona's script and ignores the brief's scope
expected: The rehearsal speaks as the person's case and does only what the approved brief says
got: All 16 traces open with the persona's user turns rendered under 'You' ('I'm Marian Oyelaran; I run Larkfield Systems', 'I'm the technology director of Larchmoor Unified'). Ruth's crop brief claimed only 'a list of each field needing notice'; the rehearsal filed 3 claims and showed '$34,527 found'
suggested_acceptance: No rehearsal user turn names the playbook persona; a brief whose claim list excludes an action yields a rehearsal with no card of that action

title: No brief or page names a rule's source; Ruth's deadlines lack calendar dates and rules
expected: Every rule applied is named with its citation; every deadline has a date and the rule it comes from
got: BRIEF_SYSTEM asks for neither; gate 'why' (e.g. 7 CFR 718.106) only in a hover title; economics.sources unrendered. Devon C2 failed 8/8; Ruth C4 failed 7/7 judged ('before the 15th', 'within 72 hours of the freeze', no SF-425 date)
suggested_acceptance: Each brief line that applies a rule ends with its citation from the playbook's sources; each deadline line carries a calendar date

title: Shaped rehearsals show stale answer-key outcomes: correct acts labelled 'Fell for a trap' / 'Unfounded'
expected: When the answer key no longer fits, cards carry no right/wrong verdict
got: Showcase says 'no dollar figure is claimed' yet turn cards render OUTCOME_WORDS: Devon's BL-107 (NAICS 238220 bid he qualifies for at $5.32M; key written for $21.4M) shows 'Fell for a trap'; Ruth's PAY-Q3-DALE (Dale at timesheet share, as her brief said) shows 'Unfounded'
suggested_acceptance: With found_reason 'shaped', TurnView renders no outcome word or tone on cards

title: Three kinds of 'money' on one page with no key; count weights and wage weights shown as dollars; restricted double-counts
expected: Every dollar on a page is money of one stated kind; counts render as counts
got: Value estimate vs 'Filed on the bench' vs rehearsal 'found'. bid '$10' and records '$9' are $1 count weights; fsa '$132.65' is 7 x $18.95 wage weights; restricted shows '$74,600' filed under a hero 'Released - $59,600' (the extra $15,000 is the 9,000 + 6,000 reports of already-counted releases)
suggested_acceptance: A playbook whose basis calls its weights 'count' or 'price avoided' renders 'N of M right', never $; the restricted total equals the hero's released sum

title: Brief headings fixed to Setup / What I'll claim / Left alone; approvals buried; 'claim' in its internal sense
expected: Brief lists, in order: what she prepares, what needs approval, what she never does alone
got: Headings hard-coded; approvals appear as 'Athena asks you before ...' setup bullets; Devon C5 failed 8/8
suggested_acceptance: Brief renders 'She prepares / Needs your OK / Never on her own' sections; no 'claim' heading outside claim chores

title: Interview offers the template's invented portals and the persona's scale as options
expected: Options in the person's terms; ask what they use rather than naming bench fictions
got: Nearly every first card offered Bidmoor/Contractdesk/Postwren/Ledgerwren/Binderwell/Mailnest; Ruth: 'Never heard of Contractdesk or Postwren'. Bid chore offered Ruth IT/HVAC work and receipts 'in millions' (hers $338,000)
suggested_acceptance: No question card shows an invented portal name as an option; numeric options are derived from the person's stated scale

title: Brief restates the example world's facts as the person's case
expected: Brief states only what the person said or research found; anything else is marked as a guess
got: After one apps-only question, Devon's records brief lists 12 open requests, $12 of $584, $1,840 estimate, F-2's lapsed window and 'Requestbright's $249 offer' (world fictions) with no guess marker; _brief_sections seeds claim/left lists from the playbook's brief
suggested_acceptance: A brief line whose figure or name does not appear in the person's answers or a research finding carries '(my guess)' or is dropped

title: Topic page never says in words whether Athena files or only prepares
expected: A plain line: what she prepares, that nothing is sent until you approve, who submits
got: Titles and steps say 'filed' / 'Files a Form 471' / 'files the SF-425'; ask-first only as diamond legend (judges' 'never says asks first' is refuted). Ruth raised it in asides on 8/8 chores
suggested_acceptance: Topic hero carries one sentence 'She prepares X; nothing goes to <office> until you approve each one'

title: 'Start for real' does not state its consequence
expected: Says what she will do on real accounts, what needs approval, and where to see it (Due, Runs)
got: Only 'Hands the brief's command to Athena. It waits in her composer until you send it.'
suggested_acceptance: Under Start for real: 'On your real <apps>, she will prepare...; each <gate> waits for your OK; results appear under Runs'

title: Rehearsal cards show no reason, and the items she left alone are not shown
expected: Each act and each left-alone item says why
got: BenchCard.why exists; turn card renders key, action, outcome word and value only; no left-alone list
suggested_acceptance: Each rehearsal card shows its why; a 'Left alone' list follows the last turn

title: Several questions per card (2-4) for a phone user who wants one at a time
expected: At most one question at a time for low-tech users
got: Prompt allows 'At most 4 questions'; Ruth C5 failed 8/8
suggested_acceptance: Studio has a one-question-per-card mode (or narrow-width default)

title: Internal jargon on every screen
expected: No rubric jargon without explanation
got: Catalogue: 'benched exceed the bar', 'found on the bench', 'Best edge' (3). Topic: persona, Traps avoided/on the bench, world, claims right, brief, turn (7). Studio+showcase: The brief, draft N, slot, rehearses, world, What I'll claim, benched run, cards, answer key, Turn N, Fell for a trap (9-10)
suggested_acceptance: A copy test fails on any rubric jargon word in rendered chores strings

title: Rules of law left as '(my guess)' in briefs (harness ran research off)
expected: Rules settled by research and cited; the person is never asked a rule
got: 27 guess lines across 16 briefs; ~18 are rules or arithmetic (50% limit, 72 h, 28 days, $1 floor, 40 days, Iowa ch. 22, double-crop, PP, ASC 958 corpus). Bid interview asked Devon the 50% rule despite 'Never ask what public sources can answer'. Research lanes were off in the UAT, so production may confirm these
suggested_acceptance: Rerun J7 with research lanes on: no rule-of-law slot remains 'guessed'; interview never asks a rule

title: Verdict sentence and n=1 sample computed but never rendered
expected: A claim resting on one run says n=1 where it is shown
got: verdictOf builds sentence/runs/sample; no .tsx renders them (judges' quoted 'Exceeds (n=1)' came from numbers.json, not the UI)
suggested_acceptance: The time-saved figure carries 'one run' / 'n of m runs'

title: Freeze brief misstates the notice trigger and over-generalises 'no second notice'
expected: 72 hours from initial discovery of damage; a noticed unit needs no second notice only for the same cause
got: Brief: 'notice is due within 72 hours of the freeze' (confirmed slot) and 'Units you already gave notice on get no second notice (my guess)'; Athena's own rehearsal read 'one per unit and cause'
suggested_acceptance: Brief says 'within 72 hours of finding the damage (7 CFR 457.8 s14)' and 'no second notice for the same cause'

title: Crop playbook omits 'don't harvest or destroy before appraisal / leave samples' and Revenue Protection
expected: Policy duties an agent would name: preserve damaged crop or leave representative samples; RP harvest-price terms
got: Chore covers notice, causes and YP indemnity only; caveat says YP kept simple (offline knowledge for the omitted duties)
suggested_acceptance: Playbook steps/traps include the appraisal-before-harvest duty; topic states the RP limitation

got: Basis: 'no programme dollar is built on it', weights 7 x $18.95 = $132.65; value_usd 10,000

got: Trap and Ruth's brief leave the wet field off the report entirely (offline knowledge, verify against FSA handbook 2-CP)
